tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi phrin las dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so:

rgya gar skad du: ye sarba ma ya: ha yaṃ grī wa rā tsa dhe wa bha karma nā ma: bod skad du: dpal rta mgrin rgyal po dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud pa la drag po'i lha tshogs kyi phrin las zhes bya ba: bcom ldan 'das dbang gi lha tshogs dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud pa la phyag 'tshal lo: dbang drag sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas: dben pa'i gnas su yo byad sogs: sgrub rdzas mchod gtor legs par bshams: bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung bca': dang po skyabs 'gro bya ba ni: na mo: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i thugs rje che: dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i rta mgrin lha: bdag ni skyabs mchi yi dam khyed bsgrubs te: gdug pa tshar gcod sems can drang bar bya'o: rang nyid dpal chen skur gsal bgegs gtor bshams la bka' bsgo ba ni: hrī: rig pa ye shes chen po bskyed pa'i lha: srid gsum dbang sdud ye shes lha yi lha: ral pa dmar po sprin phung 'khrigs pa 'dra: spyan mig dmar po shin tu ldog pa yis: bskal pa'i me dpung du ma 'khrug cing 'phro: dgra bgegs bar gcod thams cad sreg par byed: e raṃ nṛ tri sarba mā ra ya rbad: mtshams gcod pa ni: hrī: bdag nyid dpal chen khro rgyal thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las drag po'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phros: rdo rje 'khor lo dbyug tho ral gri dang: rdo rje rgya gram phyogs bcur gur du gtams: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rat+na gṛh+na karma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas brda' sgo dbye ba ni: hrī: srid gsum gzhal yas rang bzhin gsal: de nas dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: gsang ba'i dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir: dbang chen gzhal yas sgo phyes shig: hrīḥpra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i blos: phyi nang gsang sngags theg pa chen po yi: dam tshig nyams chag 'khrul pa ci mchis rnams: rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags:

sa ma ya: de nas byin 'beb pa ni: hrī: bla ma dpal chen dbang drag lha tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro chos skyong phyi nang srung ma rnams: 'dir gshegs sgrub rdzas rnams la byin rlobs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: hrī: ar+ghaṃ me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo dang: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: thams cad 'dod yon lha mor byin gyis brlabs: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra hūm̐: hrī: rang byung rnam dag rang byung bdud rtsi dang: 'dod yon longs spyod dpal gyi gtor chen dang: srid gsum rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta rnams: thams cad kun bzang mchod par byin gyis brlabs: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dzi te hūm̐: oṃ ma hā pad+ma rak+ta hūm̐: ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa ni: e: chos sku skye med nam mkha' lta bu la: snying rje chen pos sems can kun la khyab: rgyu las kun bskyed yi ge hūm̐ du shar: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba rim brtsegs chags: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hrī: e las nam mkha' mthing nag gru gsum brdal: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon g.yo: ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs: suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal bar chags: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab brjid pas bzang: raṃ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong: dbang drag ye shes chen po'i pho brang gsal: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: bh+rūm̐ las dbang drag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang: dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi zla gam dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi gru chad bar khyams dang: sgo bzhi rta babs rab tu mdzes par brgyan: phyi rol khor yug rdo rje me ris bskor: ye shes lhun grub gzhal yas khang gi dbus: lha bskyed pa ni:

bdag nyid dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog gi: dbu ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten sleb par byed: zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i steng du rkyong bar byed: g.yas kyi phyag gis gzugs khams 'degs par byed: g.yon gyi phyag gis 'dod khams sa gzhir gnon: nyi zla gza' rkar rked la 'khor ba dang: sku mdog bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi: sku stegs ri rab steng na brjid chags te: dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher ba yis: g.yas kyis rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags pa la: srid pa pho rgyud thams cad dbang du sdud: g.yon gyis rta skad thengs gsum bton pa yis: srid pa mo rgyud thams cad dbang du sdud: hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa kyi gsang sngags bsgrags pa yis: 'brug stong ma lus dus gcig ldir ba tsam: khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud par byed: srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa bsgom par bya: phyi rol dam can srung mas bskor ba bskyed: kun kyang ye shes me dpung klong na bzhugs: de nas spyan drang ba ni: hrī: pad+ma he ru ka ni dbyings nas bzhengs: dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma rigs kyi gtso: thugs rje thabs mkhas 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa: dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: oṃ ha yaṃ grī wa e h+ye hi sa ma ya hūm̐ dza: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī: dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan: thabs shes pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs su: dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: rang byung dbyings las sprul pa'i khro rgyal mchog: thugs rje chen pos thabs la mkhas pa yis: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa'i: dbang drag lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi: ar+ghaṃ bdug spos me tog mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul:

gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: rang byung rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi dang: 'dod yon longs spyod dpal gyi gtor chen dang: srid gsum rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta rnams: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa dang: phyag rgya gar dang sbyor sgrol la sogs dang: gsang ba bla med mthun pa'i dam rdzas rnams: dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ar+ghaṃ: dhū pe: puṣ+pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhe: nai wid+ya: shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa: shab+da: gan+dhe: ra sa: spar+she āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā pū tsa khā hi: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrī: a la la ho: bstod pa bya ba ni: 'di ru sgrub thabs ltar bstod par 'jug: hrī: dbang chen las la mnga' mdzad khro bo'i rje: sku mdog dmar nag thams cad dbang du sdud: dbu ni nam mkha'i khams su rta skad 'tsher: zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du klu rnams gnon: g.yas kyi phyag gis snang srid gzugs khams 'degs: g.yon gyi phyag gis 'dod khams sa gzhi gnon: nyi zla gza' skar rked bcings gza' rnams 'dul: dur khrod chas brgyad lha srin sde brgyad 'jigs: rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud: hrīḥyi sgra chen srid gsum 'gul zhing sngangs: phaṭa kyis thog 'beb bdud dpung spyi nas 'joms: hūm̐ gi nga ros gdug pa bran du 'khol: phyag mtshan mtshon chas ri rab rdul du 'jig: bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jig rten ma lus sreg: 'jig rten dregs pas khengs pa'i sde brgyad ni: dregs pa gza' dang sde brgyad klu la sogs: 'chi bdag gshin rje nad gtong ma mo dang: che btsan rgyal po rol pa btsan gyi tshogs: nag po bdud dang the'u rang bgegs kyi tshogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang po che: rang dbang med par dbang sdud zil gyis gnon:

mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs dang gzi brjid 'phrog: rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni: hrīḥm hā kro ta pad+mān+ta kṛta ha yaṃ grī wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ya ma ra tsa du tri phu ti hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa: ces brgya stong khri 'bum rtags dang sbyar ba'o: de nas tshogs byin brlab bya ba ni: bdud rtsi tshogs la gtor la: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrī: khams gsum dbang sdud ye shes lha yi lha: kun la dbang bsgyur rta mgo ljang gu'i zhal: dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ha yaṃ grī wa badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: tshogs dang po 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dang: dam can chos skyong srung ma thams cad la: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: tshogs bar pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas kyis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis rnams: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang bar mdzod: sa ma ya a: de nas tshogs tha ma bstab pa bya ba ni: dgra bgegs kyi ling ga bcas pa dgug gzhug byas te: e raṃ phaṭa raṃ: dz+wa la raṃ nṛ yaṃ dza: hrī: dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs sku bzhengs la: gnod byed dgra bgegs ling ga 'di la khug: 'jam dpal gshin rje rdo rje gzhon nu dang: phyag na rdo rje khyung chen rigs lnga dang: ye shes sgo ma bzhi yi dus la babs: gnod byed dgra bgegs liṅga 'di la khug: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las dus la babs: nṛ tri sha trūn mā ra ya rbad: ces bskul zhing ling ga gtubs la gtor ma la 'bul lo: de nas zhal du bstab pa ni 'di skad do: hrī: dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig:

dgra bgegs bar gcod dam sri gnod byed 'di: rngam gtum rab 'khrugs khyed kyi zhal du bstab: dgra bgegs sha rus rngams zas khyur mid rol: ma hā māṃ sa: rak+ta: tsit+ta: go ro tsa na: ba su ta: kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi khā hi: de nas lhag ma bya ba ni: hrī: dpal chen yab yum phud kyi bdag: ma mo mkha' 'gro tshogs la dgyes: dpal gyi bran g.yog lhag la dbang: hrī: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ni: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad: skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad dang: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi: 'bar ma brgyad dang zhing skyong dang: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang: lang ka'i dur khrod bdag po dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ma hā sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan rta mchog rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: bar chad bdud kyi dmag tshogs med pa dang: gnod pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus thal bar rlogs: sdug bsngal med cing rnam rtog zhi bar mdzod: dngos grub bar chad nyams grib bsal du gsol: tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas par mdzod: dmyal sogs mi bzad 'khor ba'i nad las skyobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnas 'dir stsol: dang po'i zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma gzugs phung bcas: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ces so: brtan ma skyong ba ni: gtor ma phyir btegs te 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrī: dgung sngon steng dang gangs ri g.ya' rtse dang: spang ljongs skyed mos tshal dang nags 'dabs dang: phyogs mtshams steng 'og dag na gnas pa yi: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis rnams: slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: rang rang gnas nas 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: mi mthun bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod:

rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor srungs rkyen ngan zlog: bdag dang bla ma'i sku tshe bsring ba dang: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: zhes dul mo brdab bo: gtor mnan bya ba ni: rang nyid dpal chen du bskyed la: rta bro 'di skad brdung bar bya'o: hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: nga bdag ru dra kun btul nas: khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud: dbang drag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: rta bro 'khor gsum chems se chem: dpal gyi rta skad tse re re: dang po dpe dkar rgyal 'gong dang: gshin rje pho rgyud thams cad kun: zhabs 'og rdul phran bzhin du brdung: gnyis pa srin po pho mo dang: mo rgyud thams cad zhabs 'og brdung: rdul phran bzhin du brdung bar bya: tha ma dgra bgegs gnod byed dang: bstan pa snub byed zhing bcu tshang: brnag pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral: bka' las 'gal ba'i dam nyams kun: rdul phran phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: bro ni drag po rta mgrin bro: glu ni ma sring 'dus pa'i glu: tshig ni don dam rtogs pa'i tshig: glu bro tshig gsum dbyer med bro: stong gsum tsam yang 'jig par byed: srid gsum 'khrugs shing nyi zla 'beb: rdo rje'i bro ra khrigs se khrig: khyung chen gshog pa ljibs se ljib: las grub dngos grub chen po'i bro: dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i bro: oṃ badz+ra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam bha ya nan: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las sku sprul rta mgrin rgyal: longs sku dbang chen gdug pa 'dul byed pa'i: drag po'i phrin las ma lus rdzogs byas la: slar yang chos dbyings skye med klong du a: oṃ badz+ra mu: zhes brjod: dam tshig pa rang la bsdu: ye shes pa gshegs su gsol: lhag chad bskang phyir ye ge brgya pa bzlas: spros bral gyi ngang la bzhag go: smon lam btab pa ni: ho: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub mchog gis:

drag po'i lha tshogs bsgrubs pa'i mthu stobs kyis: mi mthun dgra bgegs gdug pa can btul nas: mchog tu sku lnga lhun gyis 'grub par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: dam rgya: rig 'dzin chen pos zang zang lha brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// //
